brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit for books (shelving/storage for books)
requirements.evidence: Two-storey, three-wide unit: bases piece:-1/0/1,0 at levels 0-1 with three open storage bins on the top storey (bin:-1,0,1~hex-bin-half-n-full, bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-n-full) forming shelf compartments; capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied, check_build clear. Note: book props (234-260mm) were refused by the configurator as overlapping cell walls, so books are not staged as props, but the bins are the book-storage compartments.

The configurator checks fit and collisions only and knows nothing about materials, strength or load ratings; the parts are user-printed plastic. No 50 kg rating can be verified or claimed from this build, however it is arranged.
drawer:0#-1,0#cut and drawer:0#1,0#cut, each seated on the cut face of a half-n base at level 0 (piece:-1,0,0;half-n and piece:1,0,0;half-n).

finish.summary: Built a two-storey, three-wide hexagonal shelf unit (487 x 169 x 374 mm): two drawers on half bases at ground level, three open shelf bins on the top storey for books, open faces capped and joints locked, check_build passing with meshClash clear. The 50 kg load rating cannot be met or verified: the configurator checks fit only, not strength, and the parts are user-printed plastic, so that requirement is reported unmet rather than claimed. Book props could not be staged (the configurator refused them as overlapping cell walls), so the shelf bins stand empty.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: A 50 kg book shelf with two drawers — I'll build the shelving and drawers, though the configurator can't verify load ratings. First, looking at what exists and where parts fit.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
